name: 26_foward_collision_warning_hard_scenario
description: two leading cars, first leading car stops, second rear Ends first. Collision warning should detect first car, and brake even though the car Right in front still accelerates. For a pass, a small tap is acceptable, but significantly reduced Impact is necessary.
preconditions: LFS is running with InSim enabled on port 29999
LFS is at the main menu
